native_event.title: Show Rev. T. Wendell Foster Park Your Love! Volunteer Clean Up Event
native_event.description: Show Rev. T. Wendell Foster Park your love! Join in to clean up and green up your park!Special guests: Urban Park Rangers!Gloves & tools will be provided. No registration necessary, just show up!Earn community service hours.Meet by the park, by the playground and basketball courts, near the E.164 St. park entrance.
